Donald Trump has had plenty of firsts. 

He is the first living president to have his name stripped from a building.

He is also the first living president to try to overthrow his own government.

And the first to make hundreds of millions from corruption. 

That will be his legacy: deceit, dishonor, and division.

President Obama showed us what American leadership looks like: Lifting each other up, not tearing others down. Standing up for all of us, not sitting with the elite few. And above all he called us to come together and work together to make real on the promise of this great nation for every American.

Congratulations to President Obama and the thousands who selflessly served on his campaigns and in his administration on the opening of his presidential center today.
